data.exact_reserve_text: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased. These increases are set out in the table below together with their effect on ultimate claims reserves.

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve strengthening on Treaty (2012 and prior)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in claims reserves for Treaty relating to 2012 and prior years

prior_year_events.event_name: Reserve strengthening on Liability (2012 and prior)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in claims reserves for Liability (Casualty) relating to 2012 and prior years

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a gross prior-year reserve strengthening of GBP 23.342m (an ~8.37% increase on opening gross claims outstanding), driven by increases on 2012 and prior years primarily in the Liability (Casualty) portfolio (GBP 16.719m) and the Treaty portfolio (GBP 6.623m). The movement is described as an increase in net loss ratios on 2012 and prior underwriting years and reflects adverse claims development and recalibration of IBNR on those lines.
raw_causal_phrases: During 2014 the net loss ratio (net of acquisitions costs) on certain lines of business for the 2012 and prior years of account was increased.
worse than expected claims experienced primarily in the US liability account
deterioration arises on the 2013 and prior years of account and emanates primarily from the Liability account

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (liabilities) 2013 comparative column. Prior year development is taken from Note 5 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which gives gross increases for Treaty and Liability (2012 and prior). No gross claims development triangle was present in the extracted text, so PYD is computed from the explicit movement table. The movement note explicitly references 2012 and prior years; narrative elsewhere refers to 2013 and prior deterioration but the quantified gross PYD is the Note 5 table only.
